g.text: 03 Turn early. Bring the lens with you.
Use sockets A + B. Move yellow J → L and blue K → M. Either lens order works.
S → yellow L → A → B → blue M → green receiver
The beam passes straight through empty D. A and B provide the only two extra turns.
◆ Installed prism ◌ Empty prism socket ● Lens mount • Top-down schematic; not the current hub footprint
